listingTitle: Avoid repeatedly copying growing JavaScript arrays
title: Avoid repeatedly copying growing JavaScript arrays
why: Reassigning an array from a spread or concat of its previous value copies every accumulated element on each iteration, producing quadratic copying as the array grows.
suggestion: Keep the array locally owned and append with push, or collect chunks and flatten once after the loop.
limitations: Only direct same-line self-reassignment with leading array spread or concat inside recognized braced loops is reported.
The destination must be a typed array, array parameter, or array-literal variable declared outside the loop; aliases, immutable-state requirements, and actual iteration counts are not inferred.
